name: Marika Shirakawa
source:
A Japanese Street Artist who met by [url=https://vndb.org/c12822] Ricca [/url] when she was sightseeing throughout London in the 1930's 

[spoiler]After many years, she eventually got married to a man who's surname is Ordet and have a child.
She is [url=https://vndb.org/c10689] Rurika [/url]'s Mother. [/spoiler]

[spoiler] her first name in Kanji is 茉莉花 but her surname in Kanji is unclear and unmentioned neither its relations.  [/spoiler]
